purpose: One geometry-changing complex-assembly native preprocessing feasibility screen; no DOE or surrogate fit is selected.

source.hash_verification: Streaming SHA256 read during configuration preparation; no model arrays were loaded.

geometry_specification.tangent_basis_precondition: Actual original normal is not parallel to global z; verify nonzero cross product when generating the deck.
geometry_specification.scope: All 257099 physical /NODE entries, including all TETRA10 midsides.
geometry_specification.coordinate_card_observation: Original /INIVEL/TRA and /GRAV use skew 0; no /SKEW, /FRAME, /TRANSFORM or separate reference-geometry card was found in the original keyword inventory.
geometry_specification.analytical_gap_invariant: n^T A = n^T; n dot (x_new - M) = n dot (x_original - M).
geometry_specification.analytical_jacobian_relation: J_new = A J_original for a common affine map of every isoparametric node; existing determinant signs are preserved in exact arithmetic.
geometry_specification.mass_check: Compare actual Starter mass with the predicted factor; no mass-compensating density change.
limitations: Does not establish original or changed element quality.
Serialization and solver precision require actual gap and Jacobian checks.
Wall-normal extent is preserved, not necessarily thickness in the phone's own axes.
Existing degenerated BRICK/wedge representations require formulation-aware checks.
This is a physical shape morph on fixed connectivity, not an independent FEM remesh.

contact_acceptance.default_override_note: Every actual TYPE2 card overrides the default Ignore=3 with Ignore=1.
required_comparisons: Retained and excluded secondary node IDs for every interface
Resolved main segment and its node IDs for every accepted tie
Kinematic-to-penalty switched node IDs by interface
Projection-warning node IDs, local projection coordinates and distance
Resolved rigid-wall included and removed node IDs
New errors or unresolved contact/formulation changes
contact_acceptance.missing_baseline_detail_action: If complete resolved association evidence is absent, acquire an unchanged Starter control with matching diagnostic settings before asserting association invariance.

baseline_warnings.meaning: Engine input missing; /DT1TET10 cannot be checked in this Starter-only baseline.
Projection on three-node segments; repeated report is not evidence of 60 distinct affected nodes.
Nodes removed from rigid wall due to incompatible kinematic conditions.
Kinematic conflicts; baseline summary reports no true incompatible condition after secondary-node suppression from rigid walls.

future_execution.environment_reference_usage: Reuse environment and DLL-path setup in a new owned runner; do not execute the historical script verbatim because it writes old paths.
future_execution.guard_policy: Do not launch when admission fails; stop and clean up only the owned process family if a runtime limit is crossed.

report_separately: Native process exit and stop reason

unselected_follow_on_work.ai_point_density_note: Changing AI point sampling or input node count is not a native FEM mesh-refinement/convergence study.
